trade_rules_of_thumb: Scale is 1-100 Superflex Half-PPR 10-team. Keep it every day. 90+ is 1.01-1.04, 75-89 late 1st/early 2nd, 55-74 is a 2nd.
Starting QBs are premium. A locked QB2 (Dak/TLaw/Purdy) beats a skill-player WR3 in this format.
Do not treat this like 1QB. Two startable QBs > one elite WR if you would otherwise stream junk.
Half-PPR: WRs hold value. Committee RBs are discounted unless they have a path to 15+ touches.
10-team benches are shallow. A 4th RB is worth less than in 12-team. Do not overpay for depth.
Side getting the best player in a 2-for-1 sends extra. 3-for-1s usually lose in 10-team unless you are dumping IR dead.

Never invent a value from vibes. Thin data (Shough, Willis efficiency, Mahomes Week 1, Jeanty date, Allen NFL discipline, Nacua Thursday, Evans Australia hold, Henderson Wednesday, Kittle Melbourne contact, Higgins heel) is labeled GUESS.
Buy Sunday cut-day risers (Lloyd, Price, Etienne, Allgeier, Stevenson) from managers who drafted before 8/30.
Sell Jacobs for any startable piece. Do not buy Conner/Dell/Tyson/Blue/Benson/Tillman/Milton/Pacheco as discount IR, FA, or practice-squad upside.
Mahomes without Fields is a worse chip than Dak/TLaw. Buy the pair or fade.
Davis and Demercado are the same Dallas cuff. Roster one if you own Javonte; do not stack both in 10-team.
Blue on the Eagles practice squad, Tillman on the Saints practice squad, and Milton on the Cowboys practice squad are not new startable pieces.
Evans practiced Wednesday and is on the plane. Warmer. Still not a locked WR2 chip.
Kittle is on the plane and trending toward Week 1. That does not make him a 3rd-round chip.
Henderson is not a locked Wednesday RB2 chip. Ankle, not full-cleared, short week. Thursday visual still MISSING.
Pacheco on Lions IR with no timetable does not create a new startable Lions RB. It just makes Gibbs scarcer.
Mendoza is on the Raiders 53, not the practice squad. Ignore recaps that demote him.

Mahomes straight-up for Dak/TLaw/Purdy without Fields — still un-cleared ACL return

Evans as a locked WR2 chip — on the plane; still groin + Australia

Conner, Dell, Benson, Blue, Tillman, Milton, or Pacheco buy-low — IR / practice-squad dead cap on a 10-team bench
Bowers for a mid QB2 — Superflex tax; keep the TE1 or get a QB1

Trading Davis for Demercado plus anything — they are the same cuff
Any kicker or DST package — this league does not start them
